text:
sasha: quick follow-up from the model-onboard rfc. i put together a short 'intake quarantine' playbook. objective: avoid taking down customer traffic while new models are validated; provide deterministic fallback + audit trail.

neil: good idea. show the handshake with canary and bench windows.

sasha: flow overview: intake -> lightweight probe -> canary (10%) -> parallel bench + runtime smoke. failure modes: bench regression -> auto rollback + quarantine; runtime latency regression -> attempt staged mitigations (kv warmup, batch reduction, fallback binary) before full rollback.

tara: who owns the quarantine flag? registry vs routing?

sasha: registry is authoritative (includes reason, run ids, artifacts). router subscribes and enforces. makes UI + audit easy.

dmitri: caveat: bench noise. propose hysteresis: require 2 failing probes within 15m OR fail + human approve for quarantine.

bench-bot: bench queued: model=delta-2024-03-06, probe=smoke-fast, est=40s. result: PASS (ppl change +0.2%)

neil: example pass. if it fails, route back and spawn full replay. annotate quarantine with bench id and artifact links.

sasha: router rollout example snippet:

```
routes:
  - model: delta-2024-03-06
    canary_pct: 10
    probe_policy: smoke-fast
    fallback: last_good
    auto_quarantine_on: [bench_failure]
    manual_review_on: [semantic_regression]
    hysteresis: failures=2, window_mins=15
    remediation_sequence:
      - kv_warmup: 5m
      - reduce_batch: 25%
      - fallback_binary: quantized-lowcap
      - fallback: last_good
```

tara: +1 split auto/manual. bench failures auto, semantic diffs need triage.

neil: ops requests: SLI for fraction of rollouts that end in quarantine; alert if >1% weekly. also add dashboard tile for canary pass rate.

dmitri: need deterministic remediation durations and success criteria. i.e., each step runs N minutes and checks p50/p95+error-rate.

sasha: proposed default: each step = 5m with success = p50 and p95 within SLO and error-rate below threshold. tenant-level overrides allowed.

bench-bot: scheduled daily bench sweep at 02:00 UTC for newly onboarded models.

sasha: action items: 1) update RFC w/ registry quarantine owner and auto/manual split, 2) add router schema and tests, 3) postmortem webhook spec. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

neil: i'll file SLI/alert tickets and dashboard mock.

dmitri: i'll add hysteresis + flaky probe tests in the probe harness.

tara: please include an example UI view for quarantine state (reason, bench id, links).

sasha: will add that to the RFC PR and ping @eng-oncall for any auto quarantines during rollout tests. ✅
